name: App Store
long_description: Download, install, and uninstall apps from the Esposito app catalog.

name: Breakout
long_description: Classic Breakout arcade game. Bounce the ball and break all the bricks.

name: Calculator
long_description: A simple four-function calculator with keyboard input.

name: Clock
long_description: A full-screen digital clock that syncs time via NTP. Shows date and time.

name: UI2 Example
short_description: Demo of the ui2 widget library
long_description: Interactive demonstration of all ui2 widgets: buttons, labels, lists, layouts, and more.

name: File Manager
long_description: Navigate the SD card filesystem: browse directories, view files, delete and rename items.

name: GB Emulator
long_description: Play Game Boy and Game Boy Color ROMs on your device. Uses the Arduboy library.

name: Hecto
short_description: Paged Text Editor with Large File Support
long_description: A paged text editor designed for large files. Navigate by pages, search, and edit.

name: Kilo Editor
long_description: A terminal-based text editor inspired by Kilo. Supports syntax highlighting and file editing.

name: Lali
long_description: A fun card game to play on your Esposito device. Requires keyboard input.

name: Lua
long_description: Run Lua scripts on your device. Includes a REPL and can execute .lua files from the SD card.

name: Numbers
long_description: A math puzzle game ported from Arduboy. Solve number puzzles with keyboard controls.

name: Paint
long_description: Draw on the touch screen with different colors and brush sizes. Simple and fun.

name: Reader
long_description: Read Markdown and plain text documents. Renders formatted text from the SD card.

name: Settings
long_description: Configure WiFi, display settings, and manage system preferences.

name: Shell
long_description: A command-line shell for Esposito. Run commands, navigate the filesystem, and execute scripts.

name: Snake
long_description: Play the classic Snake game. Eat food, grow longer, and avoid hitting walls.

name: Terminado
long_description: A VT100 terminal emulator. Run terminal-based apps and connect to serial devices.
